name: The Entropy Biome and the Rift

pages.text: The Entropy biome is raw energy. It is always critical: you get overload, events and Blazes. Collect shards here. Do not work here.$(br2)The Entropy Rift keeps the chunks critical. It is unbreakable and drops nothing.
Entropy end stone crumbles to end stone when you mine it. Use silk touch to keep it for building.
